newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Shortland to proceed with development.
newsitem.headline: Shortland to proceed with development.

text.p: Shortland Properties Ltd said on Friday that its NZ$20 million Wakefield Street development in Auckland would proceed this year following completion of arrangements with Oracle New Zealand.
The lease will be for two office floors plus all car parks on the top level of the car park for a term of nine years from completion of construction.
Shortland plans to add six levels of office space and two levels of serviced apartments above the car park, at 56 Wakefield Street.
Construction costs will be funded through cash reserves and additional borrowing. The project is due for completion late in 1998. -- Wellington Newsroom (64 4) 4734746
